title: Siege of Malacca (1574)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Malacca (1574)", at revision 1380056609, opens: "The Siege of Malacca (1574) was a military conflict between the Portuguese Empire and the Javanese under Queen Kalinyamat." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q130198666, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1574 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
